findings.title: ExecutionLogProvider port is a placeholder (storage leg deferred)
findings.description: crates/chronos-domain/src/ports/execution_log.rs is a documented placeholder. The real re-export is blocked by a cyclic dep with chronos_log. REC-C3.3 removes the cycle by either splitting NewExecutionRecord into domain or moving ExecutionLogBackend wholesale. The placeholder exposes only NoopExecutionLogProvider + a Capability alias; the rest of the ports suite today uses Null/Loop/Concrete adapters as available elsewhere.

findings.title: chronos-domain/session_id vs chronos_log/SessionId divergence
findings.description: REC-C3.1 introduces chronos_domain::session_id::SessionId (newtype over String) because chronos_log::SessionId would create a cyclic Cargo dependency. The two types are currently identical in shape (stringly-typed) but are NOT type-equivalent. REC-C3.3 services-inversion introduces a domain-side alias to chronos_log::SessionId so a From conversion keeps callers simple.

findings.title: ports/* not yet consumed by chronos_services
findings.description: The ports declared this cycle are abstract targets. Services (chronos-services) and the wire (chronos-mcp) still consume concrete adapters (SegmentedExecutionLog, native probe types, etc.). REC-C3.3 inverts services -> ports; today the ports exist but are not the binding.
evidence: crates/chronos-services (no imports of chronos_domain::ports in the current diff)
